description:
Copy the active release from one track to another (e.g. promote beta to production).

Set `action` to one of:
• run [write]: Copy the active release's version codes from one track onto another. — requires: packageName, fromTrack, toTrack

editId.description: Open edit ID from play_edit.insert. If omitted, the change is applied in a fresh edit and committed automatically (when PLAY_AUTO_COMMIT_EDITS is on).

fromTrack.description: Source track to copy the active release from.

rolloutFraction.description: user fraction for staged rollout (use with status inProgress/halted)

status.description: Release status on the destination track.

toTrack.description: Destination track to promote the release onto.

name: play_promote_release
title: Promote a release
